ios.desc:
Murmur allows voice calls between groups of Bluetooth LE capable devices.

Multiple connections between devices create a mesh network, allowing group voice calling and messages for up to 16 participants. 

The network allows signals to be relayed between devices, allowing the range to far exceed that of a single Bluetooth connection when used in a group. 

Murmur supports Bluetooth hands-free kits, making it ideal for cyclists, skiers, climbers, hikers or any group activity taking place without reliable cell-tower reception.

quotes.text:
A bit different, as it's mainly for voice - but I made an app 'Murmur : Bluetooth Group Calls' - that lets you hold group voice calls and message via a mesh of Bluetooth LE connections. It's available on Android and iOS. https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/murmur-bluetooth-group-calls/id1468540385

Doesn't really get any downloads, so not sure there's much demand for this - but I use it with some shokz bone conducting headphones for talking to my wife when we're cycling (also for wrangling our two small girls)
quotes.story_title: Bitchat – A decentralized messaging app that works over Bluetooth mesh networks
